title: Titan Pro 15K Lemon Lime Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Lemon Lime blends zesty Lemon with the sharp edge of Lime for a bright, citrus vape that remains crisp and satisfying from first puff to last. The mesh-coil pod captures each note with precision, while the auto-feed refill system keeps the coil saturated for consistent flavour. Each pack includes a 2ml pod and a 10ml refill container, engineered for the Titan Pro 15K device. The design delivers long-lasting use, clean vapour production and smooth 20mg Nic Salt satisfaction. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
